results.title: We are moving to a bigger warehouse, and taking on new customers again | Waypoint 3PL

We are moving to a bigger warehouse, and taking on new customers again | Waypoint 3PL

# We are moving to a bigger warehouse, and taking on new customers again

Waypoint moves into a larger unit in Thurrock on December 1st. Orders carry on going out through the move, prices are unchanged, and the merchants we have had to turn away this year are worth asking again.

 Waypoint 3PL 28 September 2026 3 min read 

## A bigger unit, from December 1st

 Waypoint is moving into a larger warehouse on December 1st. We are staying in Thurrock, on the same stretch of Essex that put us here in the first place, so London Gateway and Tilbury remain minutes away and the orbital motorway is still the road every parcel leaves on. What changes is the amount of room behind the door. 

 The honest reason for the move is that we ran out of space sooner than we expected to. For most of this year the limit on taking a new customer has not been the people or the software, it has been where their pallets would go. A warehouse that is full is a warehouse that has to start saying no, and we would rather move than keep saying it.

# Inside Our New 210,000 Sq. Ft. Deltaport Warehouse

 by Bill Heaney | Logistics 

Every hour a container sits is an hour of cost. Demurrage clocks, per diem charges, congested truck gates, and long drayage runs to inland warehouses all quietly erode margin on freight that has already crossed an ocean. For importers moving volume through the Pacific Gateway, the distance between the terminal gate and the first set of dock doors matters more than almost any other variable in the inbound supply chain.

That is exactly the gap our newest facility closes. As of August 1, 2026, 18 Wheels Warehousing and Trucking has taken possession of a 210,000 square foot distribution facility at 3995 27B Avenue in Delta (Tsawwassen), positioned directly adjacent to Deltaport, Canada's primary container terminal. It is one of the shortest drayage moves available to shippers arriving through Metro Vancouver, and it is now part of our national network.

# BigArena opens its sixth warehouse in Europe - near Thessaloniki, Greece

 

In early August we opened our sixth logistics hub in Europe - near Thessaloniki, Greece. With it, our network now serves 27+ markets and more than 20 million processed shipments for nearly 1,000 online stores. Here's what the new location brings and why we chose Greece.

## The new warehouse in numbers

- Location: industrial zone of Thessaloniki (Greece)
- Area: 1,200 sqm with roughly 500 pallet positions
- Capacity: up to 80,000 shipments per month
- Launch: early August 2026
- Investment: around 150,000 EUR
- Team: starting with 4 people; reaching 14 by early 2027
- 15+ companies are already preparing operations from the new hub

## Why Greece?

Greece is a natural next step for us. The market is comparatively underserved by Western European fulfillment partners, while local consumers expect responsive local logistics. We see an opportunity to help online merchants enter the Greek market with lower operational risk and without having to build warehousing infrastructure themselves
